```yaml
name: Configuration Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, main ]

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        # Install required tools
        brew install shellcheck fish zsh bats-core
        
        # Install additional tools for validation
        brew install yamllint
        
        # Make scripts executable
        chmod +x scripts/validate-config.sh
        chmod +x scripts/validators/*.sh
        chmod +x shared/generate-all-abbr.sh
        chmod +x shared/generate-fish-abbr.sh
        chmod +x shared/generate-zsh-abbr.sh
    
    - name: Setup environment
      run: |
        # Add bin directory to PATH
        echo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/bin/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
        
        # Set up shell environment variables
        echo "SHELLCHECK_OPTS=--exclude=SC2034,SC2086,SC2154" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        
        # Verify installations
        echo "=== Tool Versions ==="
        echo "Shellcheck: $(shellcheck --version)"
        echo "Fish: $(fish --version)"
        echo "Zsh: $(zsh --version)"
        echo "Bats: $(bats --version)"
    
    - name: Run configuration validation
      id: validate
      run: |
        # Run the main validation script
        set -e
        echo "Starting configuration validation..."
        
        # Execute validation with detailed output
        scripts/validate-config.sh --verbose || {
          echo "Validation failed with exit code $?"
          exit 1
        }
        
        echo "Validation completed successfully"
    
    - name: Validate shell syntax
      run: |
        # Validate Fish shell syntax
        echo "Validating Fish shell syntax..."
        find . -name "*.fish" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | while read -r file; do
          if ! fish --syntax-check "$file"; then
            echo "Fish syntax error in $file"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
        
        # Validate Zsh shell syntax
        echo "Validating Zsh shell syntax..."
        find . -name "*.zsh" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | while read -r file; do
          if ! zsh -n "$file"; then
            echo "Zsh syntax error in $file"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
    
    - name: Validate shellcheck
      run: |
        # Run shellcheck on all shell scripts
        echo "Running shellcheck..."
        find . -name "*.sh" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./tests/*" | xargs shellcheck -x -e SC2034,SC2086,SC2154 || {
          echo "Shellcheck found issues"
          exit 1
        }
    
    - name: Validate abbreviations
      run: |
        # Generate abbreviations and verify consistency
        echo "Validating abbreviations..."
        cd shared
        ./generate-all-abbr.sh
        
        # Check if generated files match expected format
        if ! diff -q abbreviations.yaml ../fish/.config/fish/abbreviations.fish ../zsh/.config/zsh-abbr/abbreviations.zsh; then
          echo "Abbreviation files don't match source"
          exit 1
        fi
    
    - name: Validate environment files
      run: |
        # Validate shared environment files
        echo "Validating environment files..."
        
        # Check bash environment
        if ! bash -n shared/environment.sh; then
          echo "Bash environment file has syntax errors"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check fish environment
        if ! fish --syntax-check shared/environment.fish; then
          echo "Fish environment file has syntax errors"
          exit 1
        fi
    
    - name: Validate dependencies
      run: |
        # Validate Brewfile packages
        echo "Validating dependencies..."
        if [[ -f brew/Brewfile ]]; then
          # Check if brew is installed and working
          if ! command -v brew &> /dev/null; then
            echo "Homebrew not installed"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Validate Brewfile syntax
          brew bundle check --file=brew/Brewfile || {
            echo "Brewfile validation failed"
            exit 1
          }
        fi
    
    - name: Validate stow symlinks
      run: |
        # Check for broken symlinks
        echo "Checking symlinks..."
        find . -type l -exec test ! -e {} \; -print | wc -l | xargs -I {} if [ {} -gt 0 ]; then echo "Broken symlinks found"; exit 1; fi
    
    - name: Validate markdown files
      run: |
        # Validate markdown files using mdl
        echo "Validating markdown files..."
        find . -name "*.md" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | head -10 | while read -r file; do
          if ! mdl "$file"; then
            echo "Markdown linting failed for $file"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
    
    - name: Validate yaml files
      run: |
        # Validate YAML files
        echo "Validating YAML files..."
        find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | while read -r file; do
          if ! yamllint "$file"; then
            echo "YAML validation failed for $file"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        # Run existing tests
        echo "Running tests..."
        bats tests/ || {
          echo "Some tests failed"
          exit 1
        }
    
    - name: Final validation summary
      if: always()
      run: |
        echo "=== Validation Summary ==="
        echo "All validations passed successfully"
        echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - ${{ job.started_at }})) seconds"
```
